title: BarrettReducerWide<N> scalar reducer for multi-word GF(2)
description:
Multi-word Barrett reduction — Task 3 of the 6fb4abad breakdown.

## Scope

- New `pub struct BarrettReducerWide<const N: usize>` in `crates/gf2-core/src/gf2m/barrett.rs` (sibling to existing `BarrettReducer`; do not modify the existing type).
- `fn reduce(&self, product: &[u64; 2*N]) -> [u64; N]` implementing standard Barrett reduction over GF(2) polynomials: `q1 = product >> (m-1)`, `q2 = q1*mu`, `q3 = q2 >> (m+1)`, `r = product ^ (q3*modulus)`, mask to `m` bits.
- `new([u64; N], u32)` precomputing `mu`. `const fn` if MSRV 1.80 allows; else `fn` with `OnceLock` from caller.
- Doc comment updates the existing `barrett.rs:21-31` "deliberately deferred" wording.

## Success criteria

- N=1, m=63 cross-check: `BarrettReducerWide::<1>` agrees with existing `BarrettReducer` on the same operands (reuse existing tests as oracle).
- N=2, m=127 proptest (≤100 cases): Barrett result matches naive O(m) shift-and-XOR reference `reference_reduce_wide<N>`.
- N=4, m=256 proptest (≤100 cases): Barrett matches reference on random products. Per-test wall-clock ≤ 5s; total suite ≤ 60s (CLAUDE.md).
- `cargo fmt`/`cargo clippy -- -D warnings`/`cargo test --release` clean.

## Depends on

Task 1 (Gf2mWideConfig), Task 2 (clmul_wide).
